title: CrestApps Users configuration
description: Settings of the CrestApps Users features, read from appsettings.json in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant.

ExcludedRoles.description: Roles kept to password sign-in: a user in any of them is never signed in by an e-mailed code.

AttemptPolicies.description: Overrides of the attempt policies, by name. E-mail code sign-in uses email-signin-send-network (10 per 15 minutes), email-signin-send-email (3 per 15 minutes) and email-signin-verify-network (30 per 15 minutes). Only the values given change.

PermitLimit.description: How many attempts a key may have in a window. 0 turns the policy off.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:15:00.

BlockDuration.description: How long a key that reached the limit with failures stays blocked, as a time span such as 00:30:00. Empty or 00:00:00 for none.

ResetOnSuccess.description: Whether a success clears the key's counter.
